contract: Feed the same complete input bytes to the candidate CRC register and to libavutil av_crc. A whole MPEG section or EBML block uses the corresponding one-shot API; the split schedule carries the register across calls. MPEG and Ogg take one byte through the single-byte entry point after a split.

The mapping is MPEG = AV_CRC_32_IEEE, initial all ones, Ogg = AV_CRC_32_IEEE, initial zero; both normalize the returned register by a 32-bit byte swap. EBML = AV_CRC_32_IEEE_LE, initial and final XOR all ones. FLAC header = AV_CRC_8_ATM, initial zero. FLAC frame and AC-3 = AV_CRC_16_ANSI, initial zero; MPEG audio uses the same polynomial initialized to 65535. Both CRC-16 arguments normalize the returned register by a 16-bit byte swap.
Fold one kind 3 record, input length and final checksum. Load the input and parse the split before the operation.
